findings.label: Pink discoloration of the tooth crown
findings.evidence: Pink tooth of Mummery with physiological etiology; visual pink discoloration of the tooth crown

panels.rationale: Single intraoral clinical photograph shows a pinkish discoloration of the tooth crown, consistent with the captioned pink tooth of Mummery, a clinical manifestation of internal tooth resorption. The article title and caption directly support attribution to internal_tooth_resorption.
